import sys
import re

def is_valid_jabber_id(jid):
    pattern = r'^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,16}@[a-zA-Z0-9_]+(\.[a-zA-Z0-9_]+){0,1}(/[a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,16})?$'
    return re.match(pattern, jid) is not None

if __name__ == "__main__":
    jid = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    print("YES" if is_valid_jabber_id(jid) else "NO")
